## Chief Concern

::: {.note-box}

Jane was admitted with an acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and developed respiratory failure requiring a 10-day intubation. Due to continued ventilator dependence, a tracheostomy was placed.

Jane is now off the ventilator during daytime hours and communicates by mouthing words and writing. She reports significant frustration related to her inability to speak. Speech-Language Pathology was consulted to evaluate her potential for voicing and tolerance of a Passy-Muir Valve.

:::
